notes.title: Changes and improvements v.0.0.13
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone, the Trader's Way event has been completed, and it will not be the last one. Now I am preparing two events for you at once that will immerse you in an interesting adventure. The requirements for the event will be character level 15, so everyone can participate and receive exclusive rewards.
Further, he made many changes, upgrades and optimizations in the game, fulfilled a number of requests from the players.

✅The saving and loading of data for pets and mercenaries has been redesigned, this process is now better controlled, as well as the movement of the character and pets with mercenaries between locations.
✅The use of the companion menu has been changed.
✅By voting among the players in Discord, it was decided to cancel the character's experience loss upon death at the Adventure difficulty level.
✅For the Hardcore difficulty of the game, 50 inventory slots are now available (there were 40) at the beginning of the game.
✅Fixed damage reduction from RPGs, could not be detected on the target.
The arms dealer has increased the amount of ammunition on sale.
✅Added the ability to hide weapons and instruments in the equipment menu.
✅Loot items and blueprints have been redistributed, most of them have been added to boss loot, as well as the parameters for the appearance of rare and high-quality weapons and equipment from merchants have been changed. 
✅The chance of goods appearing at merchants has been changed for the better.
✅Added rechargeable batteries for X-series turrets with 50% and 100% charge. They are sold at a hardware dealer.
✅The electric SUV has added power and speed.

I don't have enough time to create what I planned, but in the next update we will see new quests, new monsters, new items. Work is also underway to create maps and minimaps, as well as digital GPS and inventory sorting. 
Thank you to everyone who gets in touch and writes comments and suggestions, and most importantly reports errors and bugs in the game. I try to eliminate these problems right away so that we can all play and have fun.

notes.title: Demo version LE
notes.notes:
Greetings, friends! The day has come for the publication of the demo version of the game Life Effect. I recorded a video in which I showed and told you about the base of your fortification, so that it would be easier for you to get used to the game world of LE.

In the demo, there are many quests available to you, weapons, equipment, drones and robots, crafting, growing a companion, part of the bunker and acid cave locations. You will find about 1000 items on sale and in production from merchants.
Explore the world of LE, get to know the characters and their history and problems, complete tasks, destroy enemies, create personal pets that will help you in battle.

The database will be developed and added with content, like the rest of the locations, this can be said to be the first version of what you will see.

I will be grateful for your support and subscription, add the game to what you want on steam and VK play, visit my discord and YouTube channel, leave feedback and comments, each of you can help the project and take part in its development.

notes.title: Improvements, changes and development
notes.notes:
Greetings to all friends, fans of the LE project. The release of the demo version is just around the corner, time flies very fast, and the project is developing every day during this time. I want to thank everyone who supports the project and the YouTube channel with their subscriptions, likes and attention, because the future of the project depends on our community. I have repeatedly said that each of you can participate in the development of the project, all discussions, ideas, tips, comments on the project are accepted. Subscribe to the YouTube channel and log in to the project's discord for direct communication.

Now I want to tell you a little about the development and innovations:
The visual part of the effects and atmosphere in cave dungeons has been improved, new monsters are created and added to locations, objects, loot, points of interest, hidden places and Easter eggs.
Recently, a lot of time has been devoted to the location of the peaceful fortification, the base is expanding, its capabilities are being added, new mechanics are being added and ideas for the future of this location are being laid. The territory of the fortification base has been expanded, areas with the work of NPCs are being equipped, we are placing weapons at defensive defense points for future invasions of monsters from caves. We will give you the opportunity to make a free choice of actions, decide where you want to go to travel or armed to the teeth to go on a raid of enemy territories. Locations, as I have already said, will be interconnected by multiple transitions, if you take a network of locations of various caves, then you can go through the underground world to the location you need, as well as on the surface of the earth.
An important point that I would also like to say about your personal shelter, which you will capture and clear of the mutants living in it, has already received the first steps to create and prepare. A little bit about the shelter, this is your personal bunker that you can develop, equip and improve, it will have everything you need for life, creating and processing items, growing and building personal companions and cyborgs.

I want to wish everyone a good mood and happiness, the Life Effect project is with you.

notes.title: Cases, storage, caches, tents, changes and improvements.
notes.notes:
Greetings to all dear friends, gamers and observers, several new mechanics and changes have been added to the game, which must be told about.


Items have been added to create control points in the form of a tent or sleeping bag, in the future it will be possible to go to bed in a tent to skip the night. The tents have a storage of a certain number of slots, in which you can temporarily put items. Tents are preserved in the world, you can place them in dangerous places so that you have the nearest resurrection point. If you put the items in the tent, and click take the tent to inventory, then all the items in it will fall out of it to the ground. Tents have durability, so it is desirable to install it in a safe place so that enemies do not notice it and destroy it. Recreation items will be available in crafting, selling and farming.


Important mechanics that will significantly help you in storing a large number of items are cases. There are many different cases with different number of slots for items, with the help of them you can make caches of items anywhere in the world, or make a warehouse in your personal bunker, and the most important thing is the tactical creation of a cache before a raid of enemy bases or dangerous parts of the world. The system of storing items is the same as in tents, if there are items in the case and you take it to the inventory, then the items fall out. There are special cases in which alien technologies are added, such as a spatial module, this case allows you to store items with the possibility of carrying a case, that is, items do not fall out of it, so you can reduce the weight carried by the character and have much more items with you, especially if you went on a raid or a trip.


The gameplay component has been improved in the game, which will allow you to enjoy the game even more. Visual effects have been added and the character's interaction with the world has been simplified.
The project is being worked on every day, of course most of the information does not require publicity in the news, but almost everything is published in the discord server of the project. Since the last publication, several new locations have been created, existing ones have been expanded, new items, weapons, monsters have been added, interactive interactions with the world have been added, and much more.


Subscribe to the YouTube channel and discord server, leave comments and suggestions, each of you has the opportunity to participate in the development of the project and contribute a part of yourself to it.
